topic: 专项突破：现在完成时与一般过去时的辨析及核心标志词 (Present Perfect vs. Past Simple)

questions.question: Mr. Davies has taught music at our international school ______ 2021.
questions.explanation: 2021 是一个具体的时间起点。现在完成时中，表示“自……以来”并后接时间点时使用 since；for 后接时间段。

questions.question: Emily and her brother have lived in Singapore ______ five years.
questions.explanation: “five years” 是一段持续的时间长度，与现在完成时连用表示动作持续了多久，介词需用 for。

questions.question: The morning recess bell rang ten minutes ______.
questions.explanation: “一段时间 + ago” 是典型的一般过去时标志词，谓语动词 rang 也为过去式，故选 ago。

questions.question: Don't worry about the art project mess; Oliver has ______ cleaned the table.
questions.explanation: already 通常用于现在完成时的肯定句中，置于助动词 has 与过去分词之间，表示“已经”。

questions.question: Have you finished reading the science experiment instructions ______?
questions.explanation: yet 常用在现在完成时的疑问句或否定句末尾，疑问句中意为“已经”，否定句中意为“还”。

questions.question: Watch your step! The cleaner has ______ mopped the corridor floor.
questions.explanation: just 与现在完成时连用，表示动作“刚刚”发生，且通常位于助动词 has/have 之后。

questions.question: Lucas ______ his library book to the librarian yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: 句中有明确的过去时间状语 yesterday afternoon，必须使用一般过去时，动词 return 变为 returned。

questions.question: Have you ______ touched a live starfish during your marine biology trip?
questions.explanation: ever 常用于现在完成时的疑问句中，表示“曾经”。句意为：“你在海洋生物考察之旅中曾经摸过活海星吗？”

questions.question: Mia loves outdoor adventure, but she has ______ climbed a mountain before.
questions.explanation: 根据 but 的转折语境，表示“从未攀爬过”，never 与现在完成时搭配表示“从不、从未”。

questions.question:
— Where is Mrs. Clark?
— She isn't here. She ______ to the headmaster's office.
questions.explanation: “has gone to” 表示去了某地且尚未返回；“has been to” 表示去过某地已返回。由“She isn't here”可知人还没回来，故用 has gone。

questions.question: Leo knows Paris very well because he ______ there three times.
questions.explanation: 表示去过某地某种次数的经历（已返回），应用 have/has been to。

questions.question: Our family ______ our pet golden retriever in the summer of 2024.
questions.explanation: “in the summer of 2024” 是已经结束的具体历史时间，谓语动词须用一般过去时 adopted。

questions.question: When ______ you receive this beautiful postcard from Tokyo?
questions.explanation: 以 when 引导的特殊疑问句询问具体发生的时间点，不能与现在完成时连用，必须使用一般过去时助动词 did。

questions.question: How long ______ you and your best friend known each other?
questions.explanation: how long 提问动作持续的时间长度，后接过去分词 known，构成现在完成时，主语为复数，助动词用 have。

questions.question: Sophie hasn't eaten any fast food since she ______ her new healthy diet last month.
questions.explanation: 在“主句（现在完成时）+ since 从句”的结构中，since 从句表示过去某一时刻开始的事情，从句谓语应用一般过去时 started。

questions.question: The students have collected seventy plastic bottles ______ this morning.
questions.explanation: so far 意为“到目前为止”，常与现在完成时连用。其余三项均为一般过去时的时间标志词。

questions.question: Hannah is an amazing author; she has ______ three fantasy stories this term.
questions.explanation: 现在完成时由 has/have + 动词过去分词构成。动词 write 的过去分词是 written（不规则变化：write - wrote - written）。

questions.question: During the football match yesterday, our goalkeeper ______ the ball brilliantly.
questions.explanation: 由 yesterday 可知为一般过去时，动词 catch 的过去式是不规则动词 caught，没有 catched 这种形式。

questions.question: I can't unlock my locker right now because I ______ my key.
questions.explanation: 过去发生的动作“丢钥匙”对现在造成了直接影响（现在打不开柜子），强调对现在的影响，应使用现在完成时 have lost。

questions.question: We ______ a fascinating documentary about penguins on television last night.
questions.explanation: “last night” 属于完全结束的过去时间状语，因此谓语动词用一般过去时 watched。

questions.question: This is the first time that Ethan ______ a drone by himself.
questions.explanation: 在“This is the first / second time + that 从句”句型中，从句需用现在完成时，表示到目前为止的经历；fly 的过去分词是 flown。

questions.question: Grandpa is terrified of heights, so he ______ on an airplane in his life.
questions.explanation: “in his life” 表示至今为止的人生经历，与否定词 never 连用，需用现在完成时 has never flown。

questions.question: Liam ______ a cup of hot chocolate at 7:00 a.m. this morning before leaving for school.
questions.explanation: “at 7:00 a.m. this morning” 指今天早晨具体的已过时间点，属于明确的过去时态，应用一般过去时 drank。

questions.question: I ______ three chapters of the novel this week, and I plan to read another two tonight.
questions.explanation: “this week” 为尚未结束的时间段，强调动作目前已经达到的结果与进展，应用现在完成时 have read（read 的过去分词形式与原形同形，读音为 /red/）。

questions.question: The students ______ their science models yet, so the teacher gave them one more day.
questions.explanation: 句尾有 yet，需用现在完成时的否定形式；主语 the students 是复数，助动词应用 haven't。

questions.question: Samuel has been extremely thirsty since ______.
questions.explanation: since 后面必须接具体时间点（如名词 lunchtime“午餐时间”），而 two hours、three days 和 a long time 都是时间段，需与 for 搭配。

questions.question: Grace joined the drama club last term, and she ______ in three plays up to now.
questions.explanation: 短语 “up to now” 意为“直到现在”，是典型的现在完成时标志词，故选 has acted。

questions.question: ______ you see the colourful double rainbow half an hour ago?
questions.explanation: 时间状语 “half an hour ago” 表明确的过去时间，一般疑问句应借用助动词 Did 构成一般过去时。

questions.question: When my grandmother was ten years old, she ______ in a small seaside village.
questions.explanation: “When my grandmother was ten years old” 描述的是过去的背景，整个事件发生在过去，与现在无延续关系，应使用一般过去时 lived。

questions.question: The art teacher has ______ Chloe's sculpture for the annual school exhibition.
questions.explanation: 助动词 has 后面必须使用动词的过去分词。choose 的变化为：原形 choose，过去式 chose，过去分词 chosen。
